prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1152; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient was treated for a neck strain after being struck from behind while turning left in a vehicle. The patient described the contact as minor. Care consisted of conservative management, including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise program, and the patient attended 29 visits over the course of treatment. The episode ran longer than is typical for a cervical strain of this kind. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a soft tissue injury to the cervical region, with restricted range of motion and muscle guarding noted on exam. The severity of the symptoms reported is greater than the mechanism of injury in the history would typically suggest, although the objective findings are consistent. No prior injury to the neck or upper back is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charges for the same services. The patient is currently improving with the home program and will be re-evaluated as needed.
